Morning routine at the glass doors

Doors open, mat down, about 20 minutes. Shoot in this order and it cuts together as one sequence. Best before 8 am.

Shot list

★ marks the ones to shoot first.

5-minute reset before filming

  • Shoes + slippers by the glass doors go to the wardrobe.
  • Suitcase + duffel by the bar go to the wardrobe too.
  • Both standing fans out of the desk frame.
  • Bed: black sweater off. Beige pillows + one white.
  • Galley end: broom, mop, dustpan and bin out of frame.
  • Curtains: open every panel evenly.
  • TV + router stay out of frame.

Light in this flat

  • Sofa windows + desk get the afternoon sun. Your golden-hour side.
  • Mornings on that side are soft. Best for faces.
  • Glass doors: soft light all afternoon. Great for silhouettes.
  • Terrace: hard shadow in the afternoon. Wait for clouds.
  • Ceiling lights off. Use the lamps after dark.
  • Sunset ≈ 5:50 pm. Blue hour runs about 20 minutes after.
Scouted from 10 iPhone photos, Oct 17, 2026. Checkmarks are saved on this device only.
